result.topic_en: Mixed calculations: series manipulations, double integrals with square roots, and a computation of the Earth's flattening (Abplattung ≈ 1/299.152) from Clairaut-type differential equations for the ellipticity h(a) of layers of a rotating fluid body, with logarithmic numerical work.
